# Maatify Eligibility

> Framework-neutral PHP eligibility rules and typed decisions for managing and evaluating external Subjects in supplied Contexts, with direct PDO persistence and deterministic public runtime behavior.

Use the Package Reference for the canonical public/runtime/behavioral contract
and complete Public Runtime API inventory. Use the Usage Guide for integration
and workflow guidance. The maintained `examples/` directory contains runnable
Public API examples. The README is the overview, installation, Quick Usage,
and Public Runtime API overview. This file is navigation and interpretation
only; it is not a second contract.

Visible in the repository does not mean supported consumer contract. `src/`
internals, tests, fixtures, `AGENTS.md`, Engineering Standards,
undocumented implementation APIs, and contributor-only material are not
Supported Consumer Contract merely because they are visible here.

## Primary Documentation

- [README.md](README.md) — overview, installation, Quick Usage, and Public Runtime API overview.
- [ELIGIBILITY_PACKAGE_REFERENCE.md](ELIGIBILITY_PACKAGE_REFERENCE.md) — canonical public/runtime/behavioral contract and complete Public Runtime API inventory.
- [docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md](docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md) — consumer integration and workflow guidance.
- [examples/](examples/) — maintained runnable Public API examples.
